rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved providers incl. accredited dental/hygiene schools, AADB, ADA and its societies, NDA, ADHA, AMA, AHA, Red Cross, ADA specialty societies, AGD, VA, US uniformed services, HHS, WV state health agencies and dental associations, study clubs; others by petition
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt until the end of the first CE reporting period after initial licensure.
rules.audit_note: CE documentation due to the Board by February 1, 2026 and every two years after; random audits; keep records 6 years. Shortfall: penalty fee and 3 months to comply.

topics.who: Current BLS for health care providers (AHA, Red Cross or equivalent; online only with skills test)

rules.notes: Each period at least 2 h on drug diversion, oral effects of tobacco use or oral effects of substance abuse. Current BLS for health care providers (AHA, Red Cross or equivalent; online only with skills test) required. Supervised self-study max 80%, unsupervised max 10%.
rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code R. §5-11 (5CSR11), authority W. Va. Code §30-4-6
